class.name: ActiveGameplayEffect
class.brief_description: Runtime instance of a duration-based [GameplayEffect] applied to a target.
class.description: Created by [AbilitySystemComponent] when a non-instant effect is applied, and tracks remaining duration and periodic ticks. Not something you author by hand.

method.name: get_active_id
method.description: The handle [method AbilitySystemComponent.apply_gameplay_effect_to_self] returned, and what [method AbilitySystemComponent.remove_active_gameplay_effect] takes.

method.name: get_duration
method.description: The full duration, in seconds; 0 for an infinite effect.

method.name: get_effect
method.description: The [GameplayEffect] this instance was applied from - the shared template, not a copy.

method.name: get_level
method.description: The level of the spec it was applied with.

method.name: get_remaining_time
method.description: Seconds left, for a [constant GameplayEffect.HAS_DURATION] effect. Meaningless for the other policies.

method.name: get_spec
method.description: The spec it was applied with. Null on a client's mirror.

method.name: get_stack_count
method.description: How many stacks it has; 1 unless it stacks.

method.name: get_stacked_magnitude
method.description: A modifier's magnitude as it applies now: calculated at application and scaled by the stack count.

method.name: is_replicated
method.description: True for a client's mirror of an effect active on the server. Its effect is loaded from the server's resource path, or rebuilt from timing and tags when the effect was built in code.
